scope: research-only strict-OOF base-router ablation; does not update live inference, consensus, MC1, admission, portfolio, or execution

feature_contract.rule: only frozen causal base fields; no score, policy, outcome, path, MFE, MAE, or label-availability field may enter model inputs

supervision.validity: both policy_path_valid and aux_path_valid; invalid rows are excluded
supervision.availability: both label timestamps must be strictly earlier than the pre-held reserve start

replacement_auxiliary_groups.rule: A-E replaces all previous auxiliary target families for this ablation; former B0/efficiency/timing targets are excluded
replacement_auxiliary_groups.authority: primary 50%; retained auxiliary groups share the remaining 50% equally; E ranks are inverted because they model adverse probability

fit.query_weighting: each timestamp has total loss weight one

evaluation.aggregation: equal decision-timestamp average: each timestamp is one evaluation unit regardless of candidate count, selected count, or opportunity mass; trade-weighted aggregates are disclosure-only
evaluation.primary_metric: 0.25*ER50@30 + 0.35*ER50@40 + 0.40*ER50@50, each component averaged equally over decision timestamps
evaluation.hpo_selection_rule: any future target, gain, objective, truncation, history, weighting, or parameter comparison must optimize the primary metric and timestamp-averaged secondary metrics; pooled candidate/trade totals cannot choose a winner
evaluation.full_contract_gate: run A/B/C/D/E leave-one-group-out only if the full suite beats primary-only on the predeclared primary metric; a removed group is retained when performance decreases and dropped when it improves or is stable

promotion: development selection only; requires later frozen score, consensus, MC1, dual-admission, and constrained-portfolio validation before any challenger can be promoted
